author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Spacing must-fail fixture (Story 3.2): a binaural layer of two pure sines, 250 Hz in the left ear and 256 Hz in the right ear, beside a gamma PAC layer: a 300 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, uncoupled, 100 percent AM depth, whose lower side frequency sits at 260 Hz, 4 Hz from the right binaural carrier. Rejected at compile by the spacing rule in the right ear. A test fixture, not for listening.
